title: Lift the grounded trailer foot, turn half a revolution in high, and stow the crank
instruction: Lift the grounded foot in low. Shift the same crank into high, turn it half a revolution, then fold it into its keeper and let go.
setup: Two YAM arms with parallel grippers stand on a side bench and a separate plinth. A rigid gearbox carries a 355.6 mm-radius folding crank, a 28 mm sliding selector and a steel-like 230 × 210 × 26 mm landing shoe. The shoe starts on a fixed 380 × 380 × 20 mm plate, the selector is in low, and the crank starts deployed at 15°. The keeper sits at the opposite end of the 180° high-gear sweep. Dimensions and reset references are in the README and USD asset.
scoring: Four ordered milestones worth 0.25 each. Start with the shoe loaded on the plate. Grip with both hands and advance at least 15° in low from a grounded grip sample. Maintain at least 0.035 mm clearance with no ground contact for three observations. While gripping and clear, push inward to at least 22.4 mm. Leaving the low range at 5.6 mm before a qualified lift permanently scores zero. In high, accumulate at least 180° net rotation over consecutive gripped frame pairs and reach at least 3.6718 mm clearance (rounded). Fold the crank at least 85°, engage the keeper within 20 mm, remain fully retracted and hold with both hands clear for 3.00 s. See README for the grip sensor tolerance.
context: After coupling a tractor to a trailer, the driver raises the landing gear and secures the crank. This fixture isolates the transition from a supported foot to high gear and storage.
fidelity: Rigid counterbalanced bench mechanism with 0.79375 and 7.25714 mm of screw travel per revolution in low and high. Measured foot support increases spindle resistance. Crank damping is 0.97 N·m·s/rad. The 3.72 mm nominal stroke represents a shortened test rig. The catch uses a detent force model. Full vehicle loads, road clearance and physical hardware performance remain unvalidated.
reset_notes: Restore the supplied fixed layout and settle for 30 control frames. Use seed 0.
scores: Dream-1 scored 0.00 after 1,400 actions (70.00 simulated seconds, step_limit). Scripted YAM scored 1.00 after 1,188 actions (59.40 simulated seconds).
